<p class="sarna-lede">The {{< var project-name >}} is a literature-based resource for small activating RNA (saRNA) sequences, experimental conditions, and reported outcomes.</p>

::: {.sarna-status}
**{{< var database-status >}}**

The database is being prepared alongside the associated publication. No preliminary or unvalidated data are currently public.
:::

## What this resource will provide

The future release will bring together structured information from the saRNA literature. It is intended to make published sequence and experimental information easier to find, compare, cite, and reuse.

No provisional record counts, release dates, manuscript details, author lists, or coverage claims are published during this placeholder phase.

The associated review manuscript is still in preparation. Its draft scope informs the planned resource, but draft records, provisional totals, unresolved interpretations, and unvalidated conclusions are not public here.
